$schema: ALTER Software Technologies — Component Specs v1.1

meta.informedBy: godaddy-v132 extraction (structural patterns only: icon-tile geometry, button state ladder, card hairline+border, modal focus trap, toast motion)
meta.rule: Design values (colors, spacing, radius, motion, typography) MUST be fully-qualified token references — no exceptions. Structural constants (modal max-widths, toast auto-dismiss timers, viewport math) MAY be literals and are marked with "_literal": true. Every token path must resolve against tokens.json.
meta.pathConvention: Fully-qualified. `color.neutral.900`, not `neutral.900`. `spacing.scale.md`, not `spacing.md`. `color.border.default` for the color; `border.width.hairline` for the width. If a reference isn't a resolvable path from tokens.json root, it's a bug.

button._comment: Primary CTA is INK, not accent. Accent is secondary emphasis. Danger is destructive-only. Icon tile is 40x40 with 8px radius (extracted geometry). Every size has a hitArea — the visual size may be smaller than the touch target.

primary._comment: Default CTA. Use one per view.

loading._note: spinner centered, label kept for width reservation

accent._comment: Use sparingly — max one per view alongside a primary button.

danger._comment: Destructive only (void bill, remove line confirm, revoke). Never for warning states.

link._comment: Text-only. No fill, no border. Underline appears on hover.

sm._note: visual height 32px; touch target extended to 44px via padding-block on the wrapper or ::before pseudo-element

md._note: controlHeight is 40px; hit target extended to 44px via padding-block

lg._note: already meets 44px minimum; no extension needed

icon._comment: Square icon-only button. 40x40 with 8px radius — extracted from GoDaddy icon tiles.

leading._note: Icon or spinner. Absolute left, inset by paddingX.

label._note: Text. Never truncate — buttons wrap or grow, never ellipsis.

trailing._note: Chevron or shortcut hint. Absolute right, inset by paddingX.

press._note: Active state scales to 0.98. Restores on release. No bounce.

a11y.disabled: _note: use aria-disabled + prevent click, not the disabled attribute, when you need tooltip on hover

input._comment: Every input has label above (never placeholder-only). Help text below. Error text below in color.semantic.danger.text. All states explicit. Size sm/md/lg mirror button.

textarea._comment: Same as default, min-height 4 rows, resize vertical only.

label._note: Above input. typography.scale.small, weight medium, color.text.primary. Required.

leadingIcon._note: Absolute left, inset by paddingX, color.text.muted, 16px.

prefix._note: Text before value (e.g. currency symbol). color.text.muted, tabular numerals.

value._note: The input itself. featureSettings from typography.numeric when type is number/currency.

suffix._note: Text after value (e.g. unit). color.text.muted, tabular numerals.

trailingIcon._note: Absolute right. For clear, reveal password, calendar. Never both leading and trailing icons on same input.

helpText._note: Below input. typography.scale.small, color.text.muted. Shown when no error.

errorText._note: Below input. typography.scale.small, color.semantic.danger.text. Replaces helpText when error present.

a11y.labelBinding: _note: label htmlFor must match input id. Never placeholder-as-label.
a11y.ariaDescribedBy: _note: link input to helpText or errorText id via aria-describedby
a11y.autoComplete: _note: always set. name, email, tel, address-line1, cc-number, one-time-code.

card._comment: Default card has a hairline border, no shadow. Shadow is only for interactive cards on hover, or elevated cards that actually float. Never both border and shadow on the same card.

interactive._comment: Clickable card. Same border, adds hover lift + shadow.

elevated._comment: No border, shadow only. Use for floating panels, modals, dropdowns — not for stacked content.

media._note: Optional. Image/visual at top of card. object-fit: cover. Radius top corners inherit from card.

title._note: typography.scale.heading on md/lg, subhead on sm. color.text.primary.

actions._note: Top-right icon buttons or text link. Never more than 2.

footer._note: Below body. Separated by border-top hairline color.border.default when present.

a11y.interactive: _note: when clickable, wrap in <a> or <button>. Do not use onClick on a div.
a11y.focusWithin: _note: if card contains focusable elements, do not make card itself focusable — let tab order flow to children.

modal._comment: Modal = scrim + container. Scrim uses opacity.scrim. Container never exceeds viewport minus 32px on each side. Traps focus, closes on Escape, restores focus to trigger on close.

md._use: default. forms, detail views, most dialogs

fullscreen._use: receipt preview, printer setup, terminal-style views

motion._note: entrance uses fadeUp (translateY + opacity), exit reverses

header._note: border-bottom only when body scrolls. Otherwise no divider.

footer._note: primary action always rightmost. cancel always left of primary.

closeButton._note: Top-right. Icon-only ghost button. 40x40 icon tile.

footer._note: Buttons only. Never more than 2. Never put text links in footer.

a11y.initialFocus: _note: focus the least destructive element. For confirm dialogs, focus Cancel, not the destructive action.

toast._comment: Bottom-right on desktop, top-center on mobile. Auto-dismiss 4s for non-error, 8s for error. Error toasts never auto-dismiss if they contain an action.

error._note: if toast has an action button, do not auto-dismiss. User must dismiss.

stacking._note: Stack multiple toasts with spacing.scale.sm gap. Newest on top (desktop bottom-right) or bottom (mobile top-center). Max 3 visible; overflow goes to a queue.

message._note: typography.scale.small, color.text.secondary. Required. Max 2 lines, then truncate.

a11y.ariaLive: _note: use aria-live=polite for success/info. aria-live=assertive for error/warning.
a11y.pausable: _note: pause auto-dismiss timer on hover and on focus
